banners.prompt:
Create a NEW photo from scratch. IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
SAFE ZONE: the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Keep everything important inside the middle 72% of the frame height.

SUBJECT: an old, worn hardcover notebook (slightly frayed corners, a coffee ring stain on the cover edge) lying open on an ordinary Romanian home kitchen table, photographed from above at a slight angle with a phone, slightly tilted. On the right page, handwritten lines that look written over many years: each line in a DIFFERENT pen (blue, black, faded blue, red) and slightly different handwriting, the older lines a bit faded. Romanian, write EXACTLY these lines, letter by letter, in this order, one per line, nothing else on the page (keep the Romanian diacritics ă â î ș ț exactly as written):
"2006 - să încep engleza"
"2011 - să încep engleza"
"2017 - engleza!!!"
"2023 - anul ăsta sigur"
and the last line in fresh, bright blue pen: "2026 - ÎNCEP".
Do not invent, translate or change any letter. The left page is empty or has a few faint unrelated scribbles without readable words. Next to the notebook: a cup of coffee and a pen. The only readable text in the photo are these five handwritten lines.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, exactly as it comes out of an average phone camera. Ordinary indoor light, slightly warm white balance, soft and slightly uneven light, mild shadows, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone sharpness. Natural, slightly flat colours. NOT glossy, NOT high contrast, NOT saturated, NOT HDR, NOT cinematic, NOT stock photo, NOT a styled product shot, no vignette, no filters, no bokeh effects. Small real-life imperfections. No captions, logos, brand names, watermarks, prices, arrows or buttons. No people.
